description: A PHP template file that renders form elements conditionally based on the 'form' object provided. It displays a form row or iterates over form elements to include sub-templates.

methods.name: $this->raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw data, in this case the 'form' object, for rendering.

methods.name: $form->row()
methods.description: Returns a single row representation of the form.

methods.name: $this->insert
methods.description: Includes a partial template, passing parameters such as 'name' and 'element'.
